item.text: This creates selection bias because visitors who stayed until the end may be more engaged, have more free time, or be more comfortable with the event’s length. People who thought it was too long may have left early and therefore would not be surveyed. As a result, the responses could overstate how many visitors found the length appropriate and understate dissatisfaction. Surveying all attendees, including those who left early, would provide a more representative picture.
